Demonstrate various PocketQube platform technologies.
Description

Develop a novel method of building compact electronics in pocketqube sized spacecraft, using a shell concept shown to the left. The project will also act as a proving ground for multiple proprietary systems, from spacecraft modules down to ground station systems for operation.
